where_we_are: T1-T4 done and green on Windows, end to end. The plugin is installed at user scope on HP, and a real `claude -p` session in a shared repo is blocked by it: the model quoted the BLOCKED message and no commit was created (test/e2e-real-session.mjs). 17/18 acceptance cases pass, 3 skip (they need overwrite-guard, T5); 12 library tests. The bench was proven able to fail: mutating the guard to never block takes it from 16 pass/0 fail to 12 pass/4 fail.
next: T5 — port overwrite-guard (AC-08, AC-09) on exit 2 + stderr; it must use tree scope too
T6 — negative-control suite: one mutation per guard, permanent (three were done by hand today: the gate, the WARN channel, the bench itself)
T7 — DR-8 as a test: `git status --porcelain` unchanged after every guard
T8 — measure the per-call cost with solo and with shared, publish the number
waiting_on_albert: T9 — read the README before it goes public
T10 — create the public repo albertgilopez/claude-shared-tree-guards (an outward-facing action under his name)

measured.session_identity: (session_id, CLAUDE_PID) — probe-measured across SessionStart/PreToolUse/SessionEnd; process.pid and process.ppid are ephemeral and unusable (D-01)
measured.worktree_scope: linked worktrees share --git-common-dir but have separate indexes (.git/worktrees/<n>/index) — guards use tree scope, the banner uses clone scope (D-07)
measured.real_session: claude -p blocked; the model quoted BLOCKED; 0 new commits (re-run on the tree-scope code, with the fixture carrying toplevel so it exercises the production path)
measured.negative_control: guard mutated to never block -> 12 pass / 4 fail
measured.linux_ci: not run yet — the CI workflow exists but nothing has been pushed
measured.warn_mode: WARN=1 measured with a falsifiable control: stderr-only -> the model sees nothing (FAIL); hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext -> the model sees it (ok). D-09
measured.transcript_mtime: tracks activity in real time (2 s old while the session was running), so the liveness AND in D-02 is measured, not guessed

not_doing_and_why.koncepto: no .koncept/ in this repo — a public repo should not ask contributors to learn workspace governance that is not theirs; the invariants are the tests
not_doing_and_why.worktree-guard: does not travel: it encodes one workspace's Tier model and junction layout
not_doing_and_why.KB migration: the KB keeps its own hand-registered hooks until this plugin has flown green for a while (T13); duplicating is safer than migrating today

known_risks: First CI run on windows-latest: TEMP is an 8.3 path there and git returns the long form. git.canonical() was added for exactly this, but it has only been measured on HP — treat a red windows-latest as this, first.
